At CCRM Nordic, we're advancing innovative cell and gene therapies from development to clinical and commercial manufacturing. We're now looking for a Validation Engineer to join our growing team and support the establishment and operation of our GMP manufacturing facilities.
The role
In this role, you'll contribute to the qualification and validation of equipment, systems and facilities used in the development and manufacturing of advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs). Working closely with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Quality Control and external suppliers, you'll help ensure that equipment and processes are installed, tested and documented according to regulatory and quality requirements.
This role offers an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with structured documentation in a highly regulated and innovative environment.
Key responsibilitiesEquipment Qualification & Validation
You will support qualification and validation activities for laboratory, manufacturing and QC equipment used in GMP-regulated operations. This includes executing qualification protocols, performing hands-on testing, documenting results and ensuring that equipment is fit for its intended use and compliant with quality requirements.
Documentation & Compliance
You will prepare, review and maintain qualification and validation documentation, including protocols, reports and supporting records. You will also review supplier documentation, equipment manuals, specifications and certificates, ensuring documentation is complete, accurate and maintained within CCRM Nordic Quality Management System (QMS).
Risk Management & Continuous Improvement
As part of qualification activities, you will contribute to risk assessments, deviation investigations and corrective actions as required. You will also support periodic requalification activities and participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to equipment lifecycle management and validation processes.
Cross-functional Collaboration
You will work closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Manufacturing and MSAT, as well as external suppliers and equipment vendors. Together, you will support equipment implementation, facility expansion projects and the continued development of CCRM Nordic's GMP operations.
What we're looking for
B.Sc. in Engineering, Biotechnology, Biomedicine, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences or a related field. Equivalent experience may also be considered.

Recent graduate or up to 2 years of relevant experience within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices or another technical environment.

Hands-on experience working with laboratory, analytical or process equipment through studies, thesis work, internships or industry experience.

Comfortable working in a structured environment and documenting work accurately.

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across functions.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications
Additional experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

Understanding of GMP principles, ISO 13485 and regulated environments.

Knowledge of equipment qualification and validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), including work with risk assessment, user requirements, deviations and CAPAs.

Experience working with controlled documentation or Quality Management Systems.

Experience working in cleanroom or manufacturing environments.

The person
We're looking for a curious and motivated individual who is eager to develop their expertise within validation and qualification in a GMP-regulated industry environment.
You are detail-oriented, organized and comfortable balancing documentation with practical, hands-on activities. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different functions, thrive in a team environment and communicate effectively with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
Most importantly, you're motivated by solving technical challenges, continuously learning and contributing to the development of innovative therapies that have the potential to improve patients' lives.
Why join CCRM Nordic?
At CCRM Nordic, you'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of cell and gene therapy development and manufacturing alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about making a difference.
You'll be part of a collaborative and purpose-driven organization where quality, innovation and teamwork are central to everything we do. As our facilities and capabilities continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to develop your expertise, take on increasing responsibility and contribute to bringing innovative therapies closer to patients.

An international organisation is seeking an Interim Head of Purchasing to assess and develop its global purchasing function while leading the team. The assignment covers all entities and locations, with recommendations that balance group-wide priorities with local business needs, supplier markets and applicable requirements.
Key responsibilities

Assess the current function. Review spend, responsibilities, capabilities, processes, systems and stakeholder needs. Establish a baseline and prioritise opportunities to improve commercial outcomes, efficiency and support for the business.

Set priorities for AI adoption. Identify and prioritise AI use cases, define business and data requirements, and specify human oversight, expected benefits and acceptance criteria. Lead adoption within Purchasing, with technical support from a shared AI specialist.

Review purchasing and partnership ownership. Assess how hardware, software, other purchasing categories and consultant procurement should be organised. Evaluate how partnerships are managed across business units and recommend how ownership, coordination and performance should be tracked.

Design and start implementing the global operating model. Define Purchasing’s mandate, structure, governance and resource needs. Clarify which activities should be managed globally or locally and how Purchasing will work with business units and corporate functions. Develop a phased plan and begin implementing agreed priorities.

Lead the purchasing team. Provide direction, clarify responsibilities, manage workload and support employee development while keeping critical purchasing activities running.

Reporting and expected outcomes
The Interim Head reports to the CFO, sits on the finance and corporate services leadership team and agrees recommendations and implementation priorities with the CFO.
By the end of the assignment, the organisation should have a clear assessment of the current function, an agreed operating model with defined accountabilities, and prioritised AI use cases with an adoption plan. Implementation should be underway, with a phased plan setting out dependencies, decisions and measures of success. A structured handover will give the permanent Head of Purchasing a clear view of progress, open decisions and next steps.

Requirements

At least 10 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.

At least five years in a senior procurement leadership position, such as Head of Purchasing, Procurement Director, Chief Procurement Officer or an equivalent role.

A track record of leading procurement transformation and organisational change in international environments.

Proven ability to design and implement global procurement operating models, governance structures and working practices.

Extensive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation and procurement governance.

Experience assessing procurement functions, analysing spend, reviewing organisational capabilities and making recommendations to executive leadership.

Experience managing and developing procurement teams, with direct line management responsibility and experience leading teams through change.

Experience working with global stakeholders across Finance, HR, IT and business units, as well as with external suppliers.

Experience defining business requirements, processes, governance and adoption plans for digital procurement solutions.

Experience identifying, prioritising and implementing AI and automation use cases in procurement or supply chain.

Ability to turn business needs into AI requirements, business cases and adoption roadmaps with measurable outcomes.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership teams.

Fluency in written and spoken English.

Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions support health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
The position
As a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer at Cambio, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and developing secure and scalable network solutions across complex environments. Your expertise in network and infrastructure design will be important as we continue to evolve our WAN, LAN, segmentation and network security capabilities.
A key part of the role will also be to develop how we work with network automation. We want to move towards more automated, repeatable and version-controlled ways of managing our network infrastructure, applying a GitOps mindset where relevant.
You will work closely with colleagues across IT Operations, internal stakeholders, customers and external partners. In addition to hands-on technical work, you will act as a technical advisor, helping translate different needs and requirements into robust and sustainable network solutions.
Your responsibilities include:
Designing and implementing secure, scalable and highly available network solutions.

Driving solution design and development of WAN, LAN, WLAN, segmentation and network security.

Developing network automation and contributing to a more GitOps-oriented way of managing network infrastructure.

Acting as a technical advisor within networking and network security to internal stakeholders, customers and partners.

Contributing network expertise to larger projects, from early design through implementation and operations.

Evaluating technologies and solutions to improve reliability, efficiency and security.

Supporting day-to-day network operations, troubleshooting and configuration when needed. 

We offer:

Work hands-on with large and complex network environments, taking an important role in projects where networking is a central part of the solution.

Take an active role in designing and building our future network infrastructure, with the opportunity to develop how we work with automation and GitOps.

Work closely with experienced network specialists, customers and technology partners, giving you the opportunity to both contribute your expertise and continue developing your own.

Use your network expertise in solutions that support healthcare, where secure and reliable infrastructure has a real impact on society. 

About you
You are an experienced network professional who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to see the bigger picture. You enjoy discussing and challenging technical solutions and are confident in sharing your perspective, while remaining curious and open to other approaches. You communicate comfortably with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working together to find the best solution.
At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values.

Experience in designing and implementing network infrastructure within large and complex environments, including solution design.

Deep knowledge of WAN, LAN, WLAN, network segmentation and network security.

Experience with network automation and an interest in developing more automated ways of working.

Professional proficiency in Swedish and English.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps methodologies, preferably applied to network infrastructure.

Experience with network monitoring platforms and tools.

Relevant certifications within networking or infrastructure.

A key role in a fast-growing, innovative company where your creativity and ideas have a real impact.  
A dynamic, development-driven environment with great opportunities for professional growth.  
Collaboration across functions, in an international environment.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/IT or equivalent demonstrated work experience
Around 3–6 years of experience building web applications in a production environment
Strong knowledge of React and modern front-end tools (hooks, state management, bundlers)
Experience integrating front-ends with APIs and handling real-time or data-heavy views
A good eye for usability and user experience
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Python and/or Go
MongoDB or other document databases
familiarity with containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
data visualisation or dashboard-style applications

jobs.occupation: Head of Digital & IT to Nordic Outdoor Group
jobs.employer_name: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
jobs.description:
About Nordic Outdoor Group Established in 2024, Nordic Outdoor Group brings together leading brands within sports fishing, including Vision, iFish and Sølvkroken. Today, the group consists of seven companies and nine brands, operating across Nordic and European markets. With approximately 50 employees the group operates primarily B2B, supplying retailers and distributors across Europe.
Each company maintains its own identity and commercial independence, while benefiting from shared resources and expertise. By developing common solutions within IT, warehousing and logistics, including a new central warehouse in Habo, Sweden, Nordic Outdoor Group creates opportunities for more efficient operations and continued growth.
About the role As Head of Digital & IT, you’ll take overall responsibility for IT, digitalization and AI across Nordic Outdoor Group. This is a newly established position where you’ll report to the Group CEO, be part of the group management team and work closely with the local management teams, combining strategic responsibility with hands-on project delivery. As the first group-level role beyond the CEO, backed by an active owner, you’ll have a broad mandate to shape and drive the group’s digital development – including ownership of the group’s IT and digital budget and of our external technology partners. Roadmap work is already underway, so you’ll build on a solid starting point rather than a blank sheet.
A central part of your work will be creating a unified and efficient digital environment across our businesses. With Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Plytix and Shopify (for B2B and B2C) as our chosen platforms, you’ll lead implementations and integrations to improve processes across sales, order management and logistics.
Your responsibilities include:

Leading system implementations and integration projects across ERP, PIM, e-commerce and warehouse management.

Developing and prioritizing our digital and IT roadmap based on business needs.

Driving AI adoption and automation to simplify processes and improve efficiency.

Improving data quality and availability for reporting, analysis and business decisions.

Managing IT security, external technology partners and suppliers, as well as IT and project budgets. 

Who are we looking for? We’re looking for someone with typically 10+ years of relevant experience in IT, digitalization or business development, including leading larger system implementations or transformation projects. You understand how ERP, e-commerce and logistics systems connect and can translate business needs into technical solutions. You are also a regular user of AI tools and understand how they can be applied to improve business processes. Experience from a multi-company, multi-brand or acquisition-driven environment is a strong advantage. You are comfortable with data, reporting and BI, and understand what it takes to give management and owners live, correct figures across several companies. You are fluent in English and in Swedish or another Scandinavian language.
As a person, you’re pragmatic, commercially minded and comfortable working independently. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and know how to build trust, involve others and drive projects forward.
The position is based in Sweden, preferably in the Jönköping or Gothenburg area, although we’re flexible regarding location. Hybrid and remote working arrangements are possible, with travel to our businesses across the Nordics.
What we offer A rare combination of strategic mandate and hands-on freedom: the roadmap, the architecture and the way the group works with technology are yours to shape. You join a growing group with an active acquisition agenda, which means the scope of the role grows with the group, and a management team that has made digital a group-level priority. We offer a competitive package, genuine flexibility on where you work, and an industry with passionate customers and products.
Applications will be reviewed continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Nordic Outdoor Group is partnering with Ants Tech Recruiters for this recruitment. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Karin Forsmark at karin.forsmark@ants.se.

The opportunity
Join our IT Team supporting the Grid Integration HVDC business in Ludvika, part of Hitachi Energy. HVDC specializes in innovative and reliable solutions for power transmission and distribution, supporting efficient and sustainable energy systems worldwide.
As a Site IT/OT Service Delivery Specialist in Ludvika, you will support IT/OT solutions and services, working closely with business leaders and IT stakeholders. Your role includes managing IT infrastructure, applications, and ticket escalations, as well as supporting both office and shop floor IT/OT assets.
You will be working in close collaboration with the Service Delivery Specialist for HVDC Ludvika, ensuring business needs are met and overall satisfaction with IT services. Additionally, you will play a crucial role in integrating IT with the business operations, enhancing connectivity and cybersecurity for all operational technologies.
“This is a new, dynamic and fast-moving area where you will have the opportunity to influence and grow in the role and within the company. “– Britt Marie Gustafsson, GPG HVDC IT Service Delivery Manager.
How you’ll make an impact
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the business in their growth
Overseeing and acting as a point of contact for the IT/OT environment and responding to emergencies
Supporting the Service Delivery Specialist who is responsible for the HVDC site in Ludvika
Participate in planning, developing, implementing and maintaining the HVDC IT/OT environment
You are a team player who can also handle tasks independently and take on responsibility
You have a willingness to learn and try new things and enjoy collaborating with others

Your background
You have 3-5 years of work experience, ideally in a similar role
Experience with manufacturing operations methods, processes, and change management is an advantage
You have experience handling complex stakeholder scenarios and cross-functional problem solving. You also have a solid understanding of IT procedures, policies, and end-to-end business processes
Hands-on, installation, troubleshooting etc. on applications & infrastructure
You are fluent in English and Swedish

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​
